VOICE.CONSENT_BODY: The microphone hears everything said nearby, including the patient's voice. Each sentence is sent as a short audio clip to an external speech-recognition provider to be transcribed. The practice does not keep the clips, but whether the provider keeps them rests on its contractual commitment, which this application cannot verify.
VOICE.PATIENT_NOTICE: Tell the patient before you start: their voice and your words are transcribed by an external service. Do not dictate their name or identifiers.
VOICE.REVOKE: Turn the microphone off and ask for consent again
VOICE.IDLE_BODY: Dictate findings hands-free. Everything appears here, on the chart, and nothing is saved until you review it.
VOICE.HOW_WAKE: Say "Calypso" before a command. For the next 15 seconds you do not need to repeat it.
VOICE.HOW_DIRECT: Dictation that starts with a tooth or a finding — "tooth 16, caries" — needs no wake word.
VOICE.INTERRUPTED_BODY: The microphone is off. Everything dictated so far is kept.
VOICE.MIC_SUSPENDED: The device paused the microphone. Tap here to turn it back on.
VOICE.STATUS_PAUSED: Paused — tap the microphone to resume
VOICE.NO_VOICE_WARNING: No voice for the selected language is installed on this computer: spoken confirmations will be read in another voice and may be hard to follow. Install the system voice, or check the screen.
VOICE.IGNORED: Not taken as a command (start with "Calypso"): {{text}}
VOICE.STAGED_HINT: Not saved yet — you review everything when the session ends.
VOICE.STAGED_EMPTY: Nothing dictated yet. Try "Calypso, tooth 16, occlusal caries".
VOICE.SAVED_BODY: The findings are now on the chart and in the clinical record.
VOICE.TAP_TOOTH_HINT: Tap a tooth to make it "that tooth" for the next command.
VOICE.REVIEW_FAILED: {{count}} entries could not be saved. The rest were written; these are still staged.
VOICE.REVIEW_DICTATED_HINT: Nothing is written to the dossier until you save. Untick anything that was misheard.
VOICE.REVIEW_REPORT_HINT: Generated from what was dictated and saved as a clinical note. Edit it freely.
VOICE.REVIEW_REPORT_UNAVAILABLE: No report could be generated ({{reason}}). Write it yourself or leave it blank — the findings save either way.
VOICE.REVIEW_REPORT_STRUCTURED: Written from the recorded findings directly — no AI narrative was available or it did not match the record exactly.
VOICE.REVIEW_TOOTH_INVALID: That tooth number does not exist (11–48, or 51–85 for baby teeth).
VOICE.REVIEW_SAVED: The consultation is saved to the dossier.
VOICE.REVIEW_PARTIAL: {{count}} finding(s) could not be saved. Save again to retry them, or untick them to leave them out.
VOICE.REVIEW_ALREADY_SAVING: This consultation is already being saved. Wait a moment, then reopen it to check.
VOICE.REVIEW_NOT_SAVED: Nothing was saved — check the connection and try again.
VOICE.REVIEW_NOT_REVIEWED: {{count}} dictated item(s) were not on the review list and were not saved.
VOICE.REVIEW_DISCARD_CONFIRM: Discard this examination? Nothing dictated will be saved to the dossier.

CONSULTATION.TITLE: Consultation
CONSULTATION.BUTTON_HINT: Records the whole conversation with the patient and picks out what matters
CONSULTATION.INTRO_BODY: The microphone records the whole conversation between you and the patient. What matters — identity, allergies, history, current treatments, the treatment plan — is picked out here and you validate it at the end.
CONSULTATION.STEP_1: Talk with the patient: everything is transcribed, nothing is saved to the record.
CONSULTATION.STEP_2: Say “Calypso, consultation” (or tap the button) to begin the examination: the dental chart commands then work.
CONSULTATION.STEP_3: Say “end of the consultation”: you review, correct, validate, set the next appointment and print.
CONSULTATION.INTRO_NOTICE: The conversation is transcribed by an external service and kept in the patient's file. The patient must be told.
CONSULTATION.INTRO_ACK: I have told the patient that the conversation is recorded, transcribed and kept in their file.
CONSULTATION.INTRO_NOTICE_NOT_KEPT: The conversation is transcribed by an external service. Only what you validate is saved to the file; the transcript is erased at the end. The patient must be told.
CONSULTATION.INTRO_ACK_NOT_KEPT: I have told the patient that the conversation is recorded and transcribed by an external service.
CONSULTATION.MIC_OFF: The microphone is off: recording is paused.
CONSULTATION.HINT_INTAKE: Say “Calypso, consultation” to begin the examination, or “end of the consultation” to finish.
CONSULTATION.HINT_EXAM: The dental chart commands work (say “Calypso” first). Say “end of the consultation” to finish.
CONSULTATION.TYPE_PLACEHOLDER: Add a sentence to the conversation…
CONSULTATION.NOTE_DISABLED: Automatic reading is off: only the phone number, CIN, age, insurer and allergies are picked up. Fill in the rest at review.
CONSULTATION.NOTE_FAILED: Automatic reading failed: only the phone number, CIN, age, insurer and allergies are picked up. Fill in the rest at review.
CONSULTATION.NOTE_TRUNCATED: The conversation is long: only its most recent part is read.
CONSULTATION.NOTE_OFFLINE: Connection lost: the conversation is kept and will be read again as soon as possible.
CONSULTATION.APPROX_DOB: Will be saved as an approximate date of birth: 1 January {{year}}
CONSULTATION.PLAN_TOTAL_PARTIAL: Partial total (some procedures have no price)
CONSULTATION.REVIEW_DONE: Everything is decided: you can save.
CONSULTATION.CHART_EMPTY: No finding dictated on the chart.
CONSULTATION.REPORT_HINT: This text is added to the printed report and saved as a note in the record. Allergies, history, plan and appointment are already printed in their own sections.
CONSULTATION.SAVE_BLOCKED: Validate or remove {{count}} more item(s) to be able to save.
CONSULTATION.SAVED_BODY: The record is up to date. Print the documents below.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_START: The consultation could not start. Check the connection and try again.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_PHASE: Could not move on to the examination.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_END: The consultation could not be ended. Try again.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_DISCARD_PARTLY_SAVED: Some chart findings are already saved to the chart: save the consultation to finish it — discarding would not remove them.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_SAVE: The consultation could not be saved. Try again.
CONSULTATION.ERROR_CHART_SAVE: {{count}} chart finding(s) could not be saved. Nothing else was saved: correct or untick them, then try again.

DOC.UNPRICED_NOTE: Some procedures have no price: the total is partial.

CONSULTATION.DISCARD_CONFIRM: The recording and everything picked up from it will be erased. Nothing will be added to the record.
